description: This file defines the Address class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing static methods to generate Excel cell addresses in either A1 or R1C1 style, considering relative and absolute referencing.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Provides static methods for creating and formatting Excel cell addresses in A1 or R1C1 style, considering different relativity modes and optional sheet names.

methods.name: cell
methods.description: Creates a cell address as text based on row, column, relativity settings, reference style, and optional sheet name. Supports array inputs for batch address creation.

methods.name: sheetName
methods.description: Adds quotes around sheet names containing spaces or brackets and appends '!' to prepare for address formatting.

methods.name: formatAsA1
methods.description: Formats a given row and column into an A1-style address string, considering relative/absolute references.

methods.name: formatAsR1C1
methods.description: Formats a given row and column into an R1C1-style address string, considering relative/absolute references.
